principles: State the act directly ('penis inside her vagina, his hips against hers'). The audit of the earlier plates found 'act not depicted' in 11 of 16 images — the dominant failure was never limbs.
Name the canonical position (missionary, doggystyle, cowgirl, spooning) instead of describing geometry abstractly.
Describe BOTH bodies' limbs, and give a specific physically-coherent posture for each. The working clause for HIM is 'His knees rest on the mattress between her thighs, his shins flat behind him.'
Keep it short and affirmative; never enumerate limbs or list defect words in either polarity.
Always carry the style block; it was held constant across every good plate.
Negative: short and style-only. At CFG 1 it is inert, and the old 3649-char defect/position blacklist did nothing while forbidding the positions that render.
THE SEED DOMINATES. Expect roughly 2 in 7. Batch seeds and let a human pick; do not iterate wording looking for a cure.
preconditions: One unet family per container group — mixing SNOFS and plain-Klein on one group thrashed VRAM and turned 3 s renders into 240-576 s (all 524-ing).
Routing is in Studio: base graphs -> klein, SNOFS graphs -> klein5090, keyed on UNETLoader.unet_name.
A render is 1-4 s when the model is resident, so a 12-seed sheet costs ~40 s.

finds: Depth training: SNOFS v1.4 was trained against depth BECAUSE two similar-skinned bodies blend - our 'fused bodies' failure.
Lock the pose first (mannequin -> matchingpose9b), then describe sex/clothes in text and do NOT re-describe the pose.
Film/photo language beats tag soup: pull the camera back, side or three-quarter, 'one clear silhouette', one verb per limb.
